title: Resetting a forgotten or expired password
summary: Verify identity by callback to the number on file or manager confirmation, then reset and require a change at next sign-in.
user_steps: If you think you may be mistyping it, check that Caps Lock is off
If you changed your password recently, sign in with the new one on a work computer connected to the network so the change takes effect
it_steps: Verify identity by calling back the number on file or confirming with a manager
Reset a forgotten or expired password and require a change at next sign-in

title: Unlocking a locked-out account
summary: Confirm identity, unlock the account, and check for old saved passwords on phones or mapped drives that keep re-locking it.
user_steps: Wait 15 minutes before trying again
Sign out of email on your phone and other devices that may have an old password saved
it_steps: Confirm identity and unlock the account
Find the device that keeps sending the old password

title: Requesting access to a system or shared folder
summary: Access needs manager approval; submit the Access Request catalog item with the system name and business reason.
user_steps: Ask your manager to approve the request
Include the folder or system name and why you need it
it_steps: Grant access after manager approval

title: Register won't boot or freezes
summary: Power cycle the register and cash drawer, check the network cable, then escalate to the POS team if it won't reach the sign-in screen.
user_steps: Restart the register and the cash drawer
Check that the network cable at the back of the register is firmly plugged in
Use another register in the meantime if one is available
it_steps: Escalate to the POS team if it still won't reach the sign-in screen

title: Card reader not accepting payments
summary: Reseat the reader cable, restart the payment app, and run a test transaction; switch to the backup reader if it still fails.
user_steps: Unplug the card reader cable and plug it back in
Restart the payment app
Run a test transaction
Switch to the backup reader if it still fails
it_steps: Contact the payment processor if the backup reader also fails

title: Receipt printer not printing
summary: Check paper roll orientation, clear jams, power cycle, and confirm the printer shows as connected in POS settings.
user_steps: Check that the paper roll is loaded with the shiny side facing the print head
Open the cover and clear any jammed paper
Turn the printer off and on
it_steps: Confirm the printer shows as connected in POS settings

title: Outlook won't open or sync
summary: Restart Outlook, check connection status, and repair the Office profile if mail still doesn't sync.
user_steps: Close Outlook completely and open it again
Check the bottom bar of Outlook for 'Disconnected' or 'Working offline'
Restart your computer
it_steps: Repair the Office profile if mail still doesn't sync

title: Teams audio, video, or sign-in problems
summary: Check device settings in Teams, clear the Teams cache, and sign out and back in.
user_steps: Check your microphone and speaker in Teams settings under Devices
Sign out of Teams and sign back in
Restart Teams
it_steps: Clear the Teams cache remotely if the problem continues

title: Getting access to a shared mailbox
summary: Shared mailbox access needs owner approval; once granted it appears in Outlook automatically within a few hours.
user_steps: Ask the mailbox owner to approve access
After access is granted, restart Outlook; the mailbox can take a few hours to appear
it_steps: Grant access once the owner approves

title: Office printer or scanner problems
summary: Check for jams and toner, restart the printer, and re-add it on the computer if jobs are stuck in the queue; for scan to email, check the address and the copier's email settings.
user_steps: Printing: check the printer screen for jams or low toner
Printing: turn the printer off and on
Printing: cancel stuck jobs and print again
Scan to email: check that the email address is typed correctly
Scan to email: try scanning a single page to rule out a size limit
it_steps: Printing: re-add the printer on the computer if jobs stay stuck
Scan to email: check the copier's email settings, such as the mail server sign-in

title: Slow or unresponsive computer
summary: Restart, check free disk space and pending updates, and run the hardware diagnostic if the problem continues.
user_steps: Restart the computer
Save your work and close programs you aren't using
Let pending updates finish
it_steps: Check disk space and run hardware diagnostics if the problem continues

title: Mouse, keyboard, monitor, or dock issues
summary: Try a different port, reseat the dock, and swap with a known-good device; request a replacement through the Hardware catalog item.
user_steps: Unplug the device and plug it into a different port
Reseat the docking station cable
Try a device that is known to work
it_steps: Send a replacement through the Hardware catalog item

title: Wi-Fi connection problems
summary: Forget and rejoin the network, confirm the correct SSID, and check whether other devices at the site are affected.
user_steps: Forget the Wi-Fi network and join it again
Make sure you are on the correct work network
Check whether other devices nearby have the same problem
it_steps: Check the access point if several devices are affected

title: Site-wide internet outage
summary: Check modem and firewall lights, power cycle in order (modem, firewall, switch), and contact the ISP if the circuit is down.
user_steps: Check the lights on the modem and firewall
Restart the modem, then the firewall, then the switch, in that order
it_steps: Contact the internet provider if the connection is still down

title: VPN won't connect
summary: Confirm home internet works, update the VPN client, re-enter credentials, and approve the MFA prompt on your phone.
user_steps: Make sure your home internet works first
Update the VPN client
Sign in again and approve the MFA prompt on your phone
it_steps: Check the VPN account if it still fails

title: Requesting new software
summary: Submit the Software Request catalog item; licensed software needs manager approval before install.
user_steps: Submit the Software Request form
Ask your manager to approve it
it_steps: Install the software after approval

title: Application crashing or showing errors
summary: Reopen the app, install pending updates, and repair or reinstall if it still crashes; include the exact error text.
user_steps: Close the app and open it again
Install any pending updates
Write down the exact error message
it_steps: Repair or reinstall the app if it keeps failing

title: Desk phone or voicemail problems
summary: Check the network cable into the phone, unplug it for 10 seconds, and reset the voicemail PIN from the admin portal if needed.
user_steps: Check that the network cable is plugged into the phone
Unplug the phone for 10 seconds and plug it back in
it_steps: Reset the voicemail PIN from the admin portal if needed
